SIM Desk is a completed SMS gateway. The operator types a number and a message at https://simdesk.induswebagency.com. The paired Android phone sends that text through its own SIM, and replies show in the same conversation as received. Outbound texts show queued, sent, delivered, or failed. New replies can be filtered as unread.

Repository: https://github.com/mafzalkalwardev/sim-desk
Creator: Muhammad Afzal Kalwar (mafzalkalwardev)
Run: npm run dev
